test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that has the same relation to the fifth term as the fourth term is to the third term, and the second term is to the first term.

MOTHER : OMHTRE :: DAUGHTER : ADGUTHRE :: SIBLINGS : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

MOTHER : OMHTRE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c6f2263dd744e17c9990e5079e262203fbf75fa8d20e112b78b22a716fddb47.png] 

DAUGHTER : ADGUTHRE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18ee68b8c2557a11f38d35a6809c5acca5abfd4971f168985e6ec1617a1ca4c1.png] 

Similarly, SIBLINGS : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cb24917e282f3b7eae9284653e76e67f97063929261c613b88e84bb245ff26a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**ISLBNISG**".
